title: Visit funded by a third party (sponsor)

documents.label: Sponsor bank statement
lines: Institution status: regulated bank; a financial institution permitted for visa funds; keeps all records electronically
Days between the closing balance date and the application date: 7

documents.label: Sponsor letter
lines: I am the sibling of Golden Sponsored and have known them all my life.
I am lawfully resident in the UK and I have never breached immigration laws.
I will pay for flights, accommodation and daily costs for the whole 14 day visit.
I can afford this from my own salary and my savings, shown in my bank statement.

paragraphs: I am visiting my sibling for two weeks. My sibling will pay for my flights, my stay and my daily costs, as set out in their letter.
We speak every week and have supported each other for many years. I will return home to my job when the visit ends.

label.rationale: V 4.3(a)-(c) are the third-party conditions the letter and statement address; the base band comes from the synthetic score, concerns would cap it below strong.

purpose: A third-party funded visit exercising the three V 4.3 conditions, with no numeric threshold.
